commandDescription.zh-CN: [usage|injections|config] - 查看上下文用量与注入内容

argumentInjections.zh-CN: 查看初始上下文注入内容

argumentConfig.zh-CN: 创建带默认值的配置文件
argumentConfig.en-US: Create config file populated with defaults

tuiOnly.zh-CN: /context {view} 只在 TUI 模式下可用。
tuiOnly.en-US: /context {view} is available in TUI mode only.

probeCompactionInProgress.zh-CN: 无法执行静默探测：正在压缩上下文。
probeCompactionInProgress.en-US: Silent probe unavailable: context compaction is in progress.

probeNoModel.zh-CN: 无法执行静默探测：未选择模型。
probeNoModel.en-US: Silent probe unavailable: no model is selected.

probeNoAuth.zh-CN: 无法执行静默探测：{provider} 没有配置鉴权。
probeNoAuth.en-US: Silent probe unavailable: {provider} has no configured authentication.

probeNoCapture.en-US: Silent probe did not capture Initial.

fallbackDegraded.zh-CN: {reason} 未观察到扩展新增内容。

usageDescription.zh-CN: 下一次模型请求的上下文估计。Token 计数为近似值，可能与提供方估计不同。
usageDescription.en-US: Estimated context for the next model request. Token counts are approximate and may differ from the provider's estimate.

invisibleReasoningDescription.zh-CN: 条目标题格式：[DD-MM-YYYY] [assistant] 可见 + 推理 ≈不可见 (≈合计)。≈ 为提供方报告计数；~ 为无明细时的粗略估计，且不计入分类合计。当提供方随消息回放加密推理时，Encoded 会替换 Reasoning。
invisibleReasoningDescription.en-US: Entry headers read: [DD-MM-YYYY] [assistant] visible + Reasoning ≈invisible (≈total). ≈ is a provider-reported count; ~ is a rough approximation when no breakdown is reported and excluded from category totals. Encoded replaces Reasoning when the provider replays encrypted reasoning with its message.

noContentCaptured.en-US: No content captured for this category.

injectionsDescription.zh-CN: 首次请求注入模型上下文的内容，附带 token 估计。
injectionsDescription.en-US: Injections into the model context for the first turn, with token estimates.

degradedFallback.zh-CN: [已降级：使用 pi 原生回退]

markerHighlightedExplanation.zh-CN: 部分由扩展注入 pi 的系统提示。它们不计入 System Prompt token，而计入注入该内容的扩展。
markerHighlightedExplanation.en-US: parts are injected by extensions into pi’s system prompt. They are excluded from the System Prompt token count and included in the injecting extension’s count.

markerGuessExplanation.zh-CN: 来源是从注入文本本身推断的。
markerGuessExplanation.en-US: sources are inferred from the injected text itself.

markerDroppedExplanation.zh-CN: 部分已被自定义系统提示替换，不计入任何位置。
markerDroppedExplanation.en-US: parts were replaced by a custom system prompt and are counted nowhere.

markerMovedExplanation.zh-CN: 块在系统提示中的位置与通常不同。其 token 计数不变。
markerMovedExplanation.en-US: blocks appear in a different position in the system prompt than usual. Their token counts are unchanged.
